about: What must always hold in Synabit, checked while it runs (a line `[invariant] {json}` in the log), over a vault by `npm run audit`, over random notes by the property test (`roundTrip.property.spec`) and over random use of the UI by `npm run monkey`. Read by the front end (src/shared/invariants) and by Rust (src-tauri/src/invariants.rs), like the other contracts here. Add a rule here before checking it anywhere.

invariants.rule: A note saved and opened again holds every word and every link it held.
Two devices that have synced hold the same notes, byte for byte.
Nothing holds the page's thread for more than half a second.
A visible window's page answers. One that stops is seen from outside it, since it cannot report itself.
No error reaches the top of the page uncaught.
An answer that says something was saved, written, created or changed stands on a tool call that went through.

claims.about: Words an answer uses to say it did something, in the person's languages. Matched case-insensitively where a word starts, in the answer's first 300 characters before any code fence: "Đã cập nhật" under a diagram the answer drew describes the answer, not a change. First person only in English: "the note you saved" is not a claim.
